scope: Authored structural resource-admissibility benchmark; not a real allocation trace, allocator, measured speedup or learned hardware safety envelope.
reference_comparison: The hand-defined three-box reference is an independent authored baseline, not an observed true region. Equal coverage does not establish superiority; its area/complexity penalty is reported without adjustment.
one_box_upper_bound: Each cluster-pair requires a containing rectangle with upper-x plus upper-y at least 1.12 (A/C and B/C) or 1.42 (A/B), exceeding quota1. Consequently a safe one-box program covers at most the three training points of one cluster.
oracle: Exact-rational rectangle-edge projection and membership with one final binary64 square root; compared separately to binary64 postorder box-SDF/min evaluation at the same packed FP32 coordinates.
numeric_scope: This evaluates the retained packed program on the host. It does not establish native FP32 execution of these heldout queries. The predeclared native-query absolute error limit remains1e-5 for the later native batch.
